claim.ja: 整数 n≥2、κ∈ℝ。n次元CBB(κ)を、正確なℋⁿを測度とするfull-support unreduced RCD((n−1)κ,n)と、大域TestVに対するGigliの分布曲率下界で特徴付ける。
claim.en: For integer n≥2 and κ∈ℝ, characterizes n-dimensional CBB(κ) by full-support unreduced RCD((n−1)κ,n) with the exact measure ℋⁿ and Gigli’s distributional curvature lower bound on global TestV.

role.ja: 順向きは短いflowの積分展開と局所誤差除去。逆向きは熱index不等式、非崩壊frame、距離の弱Hessian比較を経て、companionの全測地線定理から三角形比較へ進む。
role.en: The forward implication uses integrated short-flow expansions and local error removal. The converse passes through a heat index inequality, noncollapsed frames and weak distance-Hessian comparison, then uses the companion theorem to obtain triangle comparison.

claim.ja: full-support RCD(K,N)、1<N<∞上で、有界大域Lipschitz Fの弱Hessianが有界連続Gを上界にもてば、すべての定速最短測地線σで(F∘σ)″≤ℓ²G∘σが分布の意味で成立する。
claim.en: On a full-support RCD(K,N) space, 1<N<∞, a weak Hessian upper bound G for bounded globally Lipschitz F, with G bounded and continuous, yields (F∘σ)″≤ℓ²G∘σ in distributions along every constant-speed minimizing geodesic σ.

role.ja: 有界測度変更とgenerator domainの閉包で可変曲率CDを得て、非分岐性と端点測度の集中により指定測地線へ局所化する。主論文のTheorem 6.1へ直接入力。崩壊を許し、F∈L²やL²-Hessianを要求しない。
role.en: Bounded measure changes and generator-domain closure yield variable-curvature CD; nonbranching and concentration of endpoint measures localize it to a prescribed geodesic. Direct input to Theorem 6.1 of the main paper, allowing collapse and requiring neither F∈L² nor an L² Hessian.
